scope.zh: JAX 实现的生存制作与地下城探索；Classic 复现 Crafter，完整版本扩展规则与世界。
scope.en: JAX survival-crafting and dungeon exploration; Classic recreates Crafter while full Craftax extends its mechanics.

limits.zh: 必须区分 Classic 与完整版本，以及观测类型、环境版本和训练预算。
limits.en: Separate Classic from full Craftax and record observations, environment version and training budget.

scope.zh: 随机二维生存世界，用成就成功率及其几何平均衡量探索与制作进展。
scope.en: Procedural 2D survival worlds evaluate exploration and crafting progress through achievement success rates and their geometric mean.

limits.zh: 原生接口是图像与离散动作；语言代理需说明封装。外部知识成绩与从零 RL 预算不能直接混比。
limits.en: Native observations are images with discrete actions; language agents require an explicit wrapper. External-knowledge results are not budget-matched to from-scratch RL.

scope.zh: 以 NetHack 引擎构造可控的导航、物体交互和技能组合任务，并支持程序化关卡。
scope.en: Builds controlled navigation, object interaction and skill-composition tasks on the NetHack engine, with procedural levels.

limits.zh: 是任务生成框架，不能把某一任务结果视为完整 NetHack 能力；旧 Meta 仓库已迁移。
limits.en: A task-design framework: success on one task does not establish full NetHack competence. The old Meta repository has moved.

scope.zh: 结合纸牌、棋盘、迷宫及诊断任务，以不同难度比较强化学习记忆模型。
scope.en: Combines card, board, maze and diagnostic tasks at different difficulties to compare RL memory models.

limits.zh: 不是单一游戏类型；部分任务是控制或序列诊断。应逐任务解释记忆需求。
limits.en: Not a single genre; some tasks are control or sequence diagnostics. Interpret memory demands per task.

scope.zh: 三维迷宫中反复寻找指定颜色目标，要求保持位置、墙体和目标位置的记忆。
scope.en: Repeatedly retrieves requested colored targets in a 3D maze, requiring memory of layout, targets and agent position.

limits.zh: 在线 RL 与离线表征探针是不同协议；额外真值观测只用于分析，不能混入标准像素评测。
limits.en: Online RL and offline probing are different protocols; extra ground-truth observations must not be mixed into standard pixel evaluation.

scope.zh: 在多智能体小游戏及未见伙伴群体中评估社会互动泛化，涵盖合作与竞争。
scope.en: Evaluates social generalization across multi-agent games and unfamiliar partner populations, including cooperation and competition.

limits.zh: 2021 论文与当前 2.0 仓库的任务集不同；固定 substrate、背景群体与评测版本。
limits.en: The 2021 paper and current 2.0 repository use different suites; pin substrates, background populations and evaluation version.

scope.zh: 竞赛协议在四种社会互动任务中检验对未见社会情境和伙伴的适应。
scope.en: Contest protocol evaluates adaptation to unfamiliar social situations and partners across four social-interaction substrates.

limits.zh: 属于 Melting Pot 的竞赛评测协议；不应把竞赛版本和底层环境重复计为独立游戏。
limits.en: A contest protocol over Melting Pot; do not count the contest and base environment as separate games.

scope.zh: Minecraft 中以多模态指令协作完成建造、拆除、种植和冶炼，并提供集中式与分布式模型。
scope.en: Multimodal cooperative Minecraft tasks cover building, breaking, farming and smelting, with centralized and decentralized models.

limits.zh: 核心基线为模仿学习的视觉语言动作模型；不能将接口直接宣称为已提供 RL 基线。
limits.en: Core baselines are imitation-trained vision-language-action models; do not imply that RL baselines are supplied.

scope.zh: Freeciv-web 上的回合制文明经营与对抗，同时提供张量 RL 和语言代理接口。
scope.en: Turn-based civilization management and competition in Freeciv-web, with tensor RL and language-agent interfaces.

limits.zh: 底层是 Freeciv-web，不是商业 Civilization；完整游戏与小游戏的成绩需分开。
limits.en: Uses Freeciv-web, not the commercial Civilization game; separate full-game and minigame results.

scope.zh: 将星际争霸 II 状态转为文本，并通过高层命令与规则脚本执行战略决策。
scope.en: Converts StarCraft II state into text and executes strategic decisions through high-level commands and rule-based scripts.

limits.zh: 语言接口和脚本承担部分控制；不能与像素键鼠或纯微操基准直接比较。
limits.en: The text interface and scripts handle part of control; results are not directly comparable to pixel-keyboard or pure micromanagement benchmarks.

scope.zh: 在解谜、平台与剧情游戏中比较单模型和带 GamingAgent 辅助框架的表现。
scope.en: Compares single-model and GamingAgent-harness settings across puzzle, platform and narrative games.

limits.zh: 必须分开有无 harness；仓库另有 Pokémon Red 接入说明，但运行列表与论文评测集不能混同。
limits.en: Separate harness and no-harness conditions. Pokémon Red integration is documented separately and should not be conflated with the listed benchmark runner or paper test set.

games: The Legend of Zelda: Links Awakening DX

scope.zh: 通过屏幕输入与游戏控制评估完成经典游戏的能力，区分开发集和测试集。
scope.en: Evaluates completion of classic games through screen observations and game controls, with separate development and test sets.

limits.zh: 所列为公开测试游戏；另有保留测试游戏，部分资源需自行提供。实时与暂停推理模式不可混比。
limits.en: Listed games are the public test set; additional held-out games exist and some assets must be supplied. Do not mix real-time and paused-inference settings.

games: Street Fighter II: Special Champion Edition

scope.zh: 在街头霸王 II 的实时对战中训练和比较竞争型多智能体 RL，考察胜负与可被利用程度。
scope.en: Trains and compares competitive MARL in real-time Street Fighter II matches, including performance and exploitability.

limits.zh: 官方实现以指定 Genesis 版本为主；角色、动作变换、自博弈对手与评测配置需固定。
limits.en: The official implementation centers on a specific Genesis version; pin characters, action transforms, self-play opponents and evaluation settings.

scope.zh: 第一人称 Doom 场景中同时追踪回报与成本，研究安全约束下的视觉决策。
scope.en: Tracks rewards and costs in first-person Doom scenarios to study visual decision-making under safety constraints.

limits.zh: 安全是任务中定义的成本约束；不是对现实世界安全的证明。固定难度、动作空间及预算。
limits.en: Safety means task-defined cost constraints, not demonstrated real-world safety. Pin difficulty, action space and budget.

scope.zh: 按序学习视觉或目标变化的 Doom 场景，以性能、遗忘和前向迁移衡量持续学习。
scope.en: Sequentially learns Doom scenarios with changing visuals or objectives, measuring performance, forgetting and forward transfer.

limits.zh: 任务边界已知的 task-incremental 协议；不能泛化为未知边界的持续适应。
limits.en: Uses task-incremental learning with known task boundaries; this does not establish boundary-free continual adaptation.

scope.zh: 在四类 Doom 场景中逐步组合环境修改，测量视觉与难度变化下的泛化。
scope.en: Combines environment modifications across four Doom scenarios to test generalization under visual and difficulty shifts.

limits.zh: 这里的难度与修改组合相关；不代表通用 FPS 难度等级。
limits.en: Difficulty is tied to combinations of modifications, not a universal FPS difficulty scale.

scope.zh: 程序化二维刚体物理任务通过马达与推进器控制物体，并评估对未见关卡的迁移。
scope.en: Procedural 2D rigid-body tasks control objects with motors and thrusters and evaluate transfer to unseen levels.

limits.zh: 包含机器人与游戏式任务，不是单一商业游戏；复现论文需固定环境与物理版本。
limits.en: Includes robotics and game-like tasks rather than one commercial game; paper reproduction requires pinned environment and physics versions.
